newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan govt asked to consider stock measures - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Japan govt asked to consider stock measures - Jiji.

text.p: Taku Yamazaki, chairman of the policy-making committee of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party, was quoted by Jiji news agency on Tuesday as urging the government to consider measures to tackle the problem of weak stock prices in Tokyo.
"Please consider, with deep interest, some kind of measures to deal with stock prices," Yamazaki was quoted as telling a meeting of economic ministers on Tuesday.
Management and Coordination Agency Minister Kabun Muto was also quoted as telling the meeting that the government should come up with measures that would be considered attractive to the stock market.
The stock market lost more than 2,000 points last week on worries about Japan's economy and was down again at Tuesday lunchtime after having made up some lost ground on Monday.
